data.name: Adheer
data.gender_notes: Adheer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adheer is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'adh' meaning 'towards' and 'hru' meaning 'heart'. This name is given to a fearless warrior, one who faces challenges with courage and determination. The name Adheer carries the meaning “Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adheer usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies inner strength and bravery.
data.etymology: Adheer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adheer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
